Common Causes of Neck Pain & How to Prevent Them

Is neck pain disrupting your daily routine? It can result from poor posture, prolonged screen time, muscle strain, or age-related changes in the spine. Ignoring persistent neck pain may lead to reduced mobility and discomfort.

Common Causes:
✔ Poor posture while working or using mobile devices
✔ Long hours at a desk without breaks
✔ Muscle strain due to improper sleeping position
✔ Cervical spondylosis (wear and tear of the spine)
✔ Herniated (slipped) cervical disc

Prevention Tips:
✅ Maintain good posture while sitting and standing
✅ Take regular breaks from screens and stretch your neck
✅ Use an ergonomic workstation
✅ Sleep with proper neck support using a suitable pillow
✅ Exercise regularly to strengthen your neck and back muscles

If your neck pain persists, radiates to your arms, or is associated with numbness or weakness, consult a spine specialist for timely evaluation and treatment.

Suffering from a Slipped Disc? Expert Spine Care in Goregaon Can Help

A slipped disc, also known as a herniated or prolapsed disc, is a common spine condition that can cause significant discomfort and affect your daily activities. When a spinal disc bulges or ruptures, it may compress nearby nerves, leading to pain, numbness, weakness, and reduced mobility.

Common symptoms of a slipped disc include:

✔ Persistent lower back or neck pain
✔ Pain radiating to the arms or legs
✔ Tingling or numbness in the limbs
✔ Muscle weakness
✔ Difficulty walking or standing for extended periods
✔ Sciatica and nerve compression symptoms
✔ Reduced flexibility and movement

Early diagnosis and timely treatment are essential to prevent further complications and improve quality of life. Depending on the severity of the condition, treatment may include medications, physiotherapy, lifestyle modifications, pain management procedures, or advanced minimally invasive spine surgery.

How Obesity Impacts Spine Health

by Dr Aaditya Kashikar

Excess body weight can put extra pressure on your spine, leading to pain, stiffness, and reduced mobility. Obesity increases the risk of conditions like slip disc, sciatica, spinal arthritis, and chronic lower back pain.

⚠️ Common Effects of Obesity on Spine Health:
• Increased stress on spinal discs
• Poor posture and muscle strain
• Higher risk of slipped disc & sciatica
• Joint degeneration and chronic back pain
• Reduced flexibility and movement

✅ Tips to Protect Your Spine:
✔ Maintain a healthy weight
✔ Stay physically active
✔ Follow proper posture habits
✔ Do regular stretching & strengthening exercises
✔ Seek medical advice for persistent back pain

Healthy weight = Healthy spine! Don’t ignore continuous neck or back pain. Early treatment can help prevent serious spine problems.

We categorically deny the allegations and the language used in this review.

Osteoporosis is diagnosed using standardized DEXA scan criteria (T-scores), which are objective and machine-generated. In this case, DEXA scans done at two different centres( Nirman and Divine - both independent,  reputed centres ) two years apart, showed similar findings, confirming low bone density - this indicates consistency rather than error. 

It is also relevant that you had already received bone-strengthening injectable treatment from a previous doctor, which is prescribed only when osteoporosis or significant bone loss is established.

The repeat DEXA scan was advised only to address your doubts and was facilitated at a discounted rate, not to influence results. Diagnostic centres operate independently, and doctors neither control nor alter scan readings.

At no point was any daily injection costing ₹1 lakh per year prescribed. Treatment options, were explained as optional and as per standard guidelines, and you were encouraged to seek a third opinion — which is every patient’s right.
